description: This Go source file implements a command-line utility for internationalization (i18n) of documentation files. It provides functions for processing documentation files either sequentially or in parallel, translating content from a source language to a target language, and managing translation memories and glossaries.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the command-line utility; parses flags, loads necessary resources, and orchestrates the documentation translation process based on specified mode and parallelism.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of documentation files sequentially, translating each and handling errors.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes a list of documentation files in parallel using worker goroutines, managing concurrent translation jobs and collecting results.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of files sequentially, translating segments within each file.
